# Repository map

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-repo-map.py. Do not edit by hand; rerun the script. -->

Built from code: `cargo metadata`, `git ls-files`, the `construct_runtime!` blocks in
`runtime/src/lib.rs`, and tracked `package.json` / `pyproject.toml` files. Descriptions
come from each crate's `Cargo.toml` `description` or the first `//!` line of its entry
file, so they are only as accurate as those. Treat other docs in this repo as
possibly stale; this file is regenerated with `python3 scripts/gen-repo-map.py`.

Columns: **lines** = tracked `.rs` lines in the crate, **tests** = `#[test]` functions,
**calls** = pallet extrinsics (`#[pallet::call_index]`), **used by** = workspace crates
depending on it, **runtime** = how many `construct_runtime!` variants include it.
